title: Q-SPEC-01-R04-object-store-gate: Gate a dropping migration on a verified object-store export in the migration runners
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "US-01-R04: a dropping migration waits for its verified object-store export" -- seed/worker/test workers/core/migrations
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-01 (US-01-R04): `workers/core/export` exports each affected table to an object store, reads it back and matches row count and hash before a migration that drops or rewrites data is applied, but neither `workers/core/migrations/selfmigrate.js` nor `seed/worker/src/migrate.js` calls it. The seed runner refuses a drop with no in-store copy (`unbackedDrops`); make it also require the verified export when the AUDIT bucket is bound, and cover row rewrites (`UPDATE`, `DELETE`) with the same rule and a baseline for files already applied.

size: M

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** additive migrations, and the daily D1 snapshot (US-01-R15), which stays as it is.

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "US-01-R04: a dropping migration waits for its verified object-store export" -- seed/worker/test workers/core/migrations` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
